value.rationale: Computes and uniquely classifies the exact first four-coordinate/nondivisible rank-three point of an active flat-spectrum Gaussian extremum, an independently motivated natural invariant. Balanced sign pattern yields an affine square rather than the globally maximizing centered tetrahedron, and a sharp positive gap to the independent-normal rank-three baseline. Full finite classification is more than an arbitrary parameter substitution; higher-dimensional implications are not claimed.
